note: Triennial election of the rural district councillors, three divisions contested (Tyrone polling day Wednesday 4 June 1930: Crockanboy, Glenlark and Fallagh); nominations were received by Mr. Patrick Gormley, clerk, on 22 April 1930. The Ulster Herald's list (26 April 1930, p. 5) is damaged at this entry; the Derry Journal's list (23 April 1930, p. 2) prints 'Mayne—John M'Farland, Fecarry (U.)', one of the three Unionist changes, Mr. John M'Farland replacing Mr. Robert A. Lyons in the Maine division. Returned unopposed.
